llmResponse.agenda_changes: One item was pulled from the posted agenda and moved: 'Staff Recognition' was added after item 5 (Oral Communication). Board President stated: 'I'd like to add staff recognition. I need to pull it up my after oral communication. Wherever you'd like it. We'll move it after item five.'
llmResponse.consent_vote_words: And a roll call vote, please. Trustee McBride. Aye. Trustee Marquez. Aye. Trustee Diaz Locum. Aye. Trustee McAvoy. Aye. Trustee Lawson. Aye.
